title: Mosey Bank page published, translation wanted
description: Sent by the site (src/lib/mark/triggers.ts) when a person publishes the source-language version of a page that has no version yet in one of the translation languages.

contentKey.description: The page's content key, 32 hex characters; pass it to the translator as content_key.

version.description: Version number of the published version.

locale.description: The language that was published and is translated from, e.g. en.

targetLocales.description: The languages the page has no version in yet, e.g. ["nl"].

docId.description: The Graph document id the event carried: {guid}_{locale}_Published.
